accepted.s: According to the Global Cancer Observatory projection, the number of cancer cases in India is expected to increase from approximately 1.41 million in 2022 to what number by 2045?
accepted.x: The projected number of cancer cases is expected to rise from 1.41 million in 2022 to 2.46 million in 2045.
accepted.tq: Use the precise projected figure rather than estimating from the percentage increase.
accepted.sec: NCD prevalence - diabetes, hypertension, cancer, COPD

accepted.s: The projected rise in cancer cases in India from 1.41 million in 2022 to 2.46 million in 2045 represents an increase of approximately:
accepted.x: The projected increase is approximately 74 percent over the period from 2022 to 2045.
accepted.tq: Identify the percentage directly associated with the stated numerical projection.
accepted.sec: NCD prevalence - diabetes, hypertension, cancer, COPD

accepted.s:
Consider the following statements regarding cancer notification in India:
1. Cancer is not nationally notifiable in India.
2. Seventeen States have made cancer a notifiable disease.
3. Telangana was the most recent State to make cancer notifiable.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
accepted.x: All three statements are correct: cancer is not nationally notifiable, 17 States have notified it, and Telangana was the most recent State to do so.
accepted.tq: Check each statement separately, especially the distinction between national and State-level notification.
accepted.sec: NCD prevalence - diabetes, hypertension, cancer, COPD

accepted.s: Cancer registries referred to in the context of India cover approximately what proportion of the population?
accepted.x: The cancer registries cover only about 10–16 percent of the population.
accepted.tq: Distinguish the limited registry coverage from national population coverage.
accepted.sec: NCD prevalence - diabetes, hypertension, cancer, COPD

accepted.s: The National Programme for Prevention and Control of Non-Communicable Diseases (NP-NCD) was formerly known as:
accepted.x: NP-NCD was formerly known as the National Programme for Prevention and Control of Cancer, Diabetes, Cardiovascular Diseases and Stroke, abbreviated NPCDCS.
accepted.tq: Test the changed programme name against closely related health-programme abbreviations.
accepted.sec: NCD prevalence - diabetes, hypertension, cancer, COPD

accepted.s: NP-NCD primarily operates NCD clinics at which of the following levels of health facilities?
o: Only medical colleges and AIIMS institutions
District hospitals and Community Health Centres
Kidney research centres and super-speciality hospitals
accepted.x: NP-NCD runs NCD clinics at district hospitals and Community Health Centres.
accepted.tq: Match the programme with its stated health-facility network.
accepted.sec: NCD prevalence - diabetes, hypertension, cancer, COPD

accepted.s: Under NP-NCD, which age group is covered for screening?
accepted.x: NP-NCD provides screening for everyone over 30 years of age.
accepted.tq: Focus on the exact age threshold rather than the broader adult population.
accepted.sec: NCD prevalence - diabetes, hypertension, cancer, COPD

accepted.s:
Consider the following statements about the funding pattern of NP-NCD:
1. The usual Centre-State funding ratio is 60:40.
2. The funding ratio for North-Eastern and hilly States is 90:10.
3. The 90:10 ratio applies uniformly to all States and Union Territories.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
accepted.x: The usual funding ratio is 60:40, while North-Eastern and hilly States receive funding in the ratio of 90:10. The latter ratio does not apply uniformly to all States and Union Territories.
accepted.tq: Reject the overgeneralised statement by separating the normal ratio from the special-category ratio.
accepted.sec: NCD prevalence - diabetes, hypertension, cancer, COPD

accepted.s:
Ayushman Arogya Mandirs screen beneficiaries for which of the following conditions?
1. Hypertension
2. Diabetes
3. Oral cancer
4. Breast and cervical cancers
Select the correct answer using the code given below.
accepted.x: Ayushman Arogya Mandirs screen for hypertension, diabetes, and oral, breast and cervical cancers.
accepted.tq: Use the inclusive option when all listed screening services belong to the same programme.
accepted.sec: NCD prevalence - diabetes, hypertension, cancer, COPD

accepted.s: Which one of the following is correctly matched with the relevant SDG 3 health target?
o: Premature NCD deaths — reduce by one-half
Premature NCD deaths — reduce by one-third
accepted.x: SDG 3 includes the target of reducing premature deaths from non-communicable diseases by one-third. It also promotes mental health and seeks to halve road-traffic deaths.
accepted.tq: Discriminate between the different numerical targets under the same goal.
accepted.sec: Mental health and road injuries - burden

accepted.s: Which initiative provides 24×7 tele-mental-health support across all 36 States and Union Territories?
accepted.x: Tele-MANAS provides round-the-clock tele-mental-health support across all 36 States and Union Territories.
accepted.tq: Link the service function—tele-mental health—with the correct national initiative.
accepted.sec: Mental health and road injuries - burden

accepted.s: Uddanam, located in which district of Andhra Pradesh, is associated with chronic kidney disease of unknown cause (CKDu)?
accepted.x: Uddanam is in Srikakulam district and is associated with CKDu. Palasa is the location of the kidney centre, while Mangalagiri is the location of AIIMS.
accepted.tq: Separate the geographical region from the nearby institutions associated with it.
accepted.sec: AP disease burden - NCD screening, Uddanam CKD

accepted.s: The interim report on Uddanam CKDu found a high incidence of kidney disease particularly in:
accepted.x: The interim report found a high level of kidney disease in Kaviti mandal of the Uddanam region.
accepted.tq: Identify the specific mandal rather than selecting the broader district or a related town.
accepted.sec: AP disease burden - NCD screening, Uddanam CKD

accepted.s: In investigating the possible causes of CKDu in Uddanam, samples of soil, water, blood and urine are being tested for:
accepted.x: The investigation examines soil, water, blood and urine for possible exposure to pesticides and heavy metals.
accepted.tq: Connect the sample types with the suspected environmental contaminants.
accepted.sec: AP disease burden - NCD screening, Uddanam CKD

accepted.s: The testing related to the Uddanam CKDu investigation is being conducted in association with:
o: The State Cancer Registry of Telangana
accepted.x: CSIR-IICT, Hyderabad, is involved in testing samples for pesticides and heavy metals in the Uddanam investigation.
accepted.tq: Identify the scientific institution by matching it with the investigation function.
accepted.sec: AP disease burden - NCD screening, Uddanam CKD

accepted.s: Among the people covered in the Uddanam assessment, the reported tobacco-use and alcohol-use proportions were, respectively:
accepted.x: Tobacco use was reported among 38.8 percent and alcohol use among 23.7 percent of those covered.
accepted.tq: Preserve the order of paired percentages and avoid reversing the two values.
accepted.sec: AP disease burden - NCD screening, Uddanam CKD

accepted.s: Which institution conducts CKDu screening camps in the Uddanam region?
accepted.x: AIIMS Mangalagiri conducts screening camps for chronic kidney disease of unknown cause in the Uddanam region.
accepted.tq: Distinguish the institution conducting field screening from the laboratory involved in testing.
accepted.sec: AP disease burden - NCD screening, Uddanam CKD

accepted.s: The Kidney Research Centre and Super Specialty Hospital associated with the Uddanam kidney disease issue is located at:
accepted.x: The Kidney Research Centre and Super Specialty Hospital is located at Palasa in Srikakulam district.
accepted.tq: Use the place-specific association instead of confusing the hospital with the screening institution.
accepted.sec: AP disease burden - NCD screening, Uddanam CKD

accepted.s: Which one of the following places is associated with Andhra Pradesh's first Diabetic Foot and Ulcer Clinic?
accepted.x: Andhra Pradesh's first Diabetic Foot and Ulcer Clinic was opened at Vizianagaram.
accepted.tq: Identify the location of the specialised clinic, not the locations of the kidney-related facilities.
accepted.sec: AP disease burden - NCD screening, Uddanam CKD

accepted.s:
Consider the following outcomes reported for Andhra Pradesh's IDSP:
1. Disease outbreaks declined by 47 percent.
2. Water-borne outbreaks declined by 62.7 percent.
3. Diarrhoea deaths declined by 72 percent.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
accepted.x: All three outcomes are reported for Andhra Pradesh's IDSP: overall outbreaks fell by 47 percent, water-borne outbreaks by 62.7 percent, and diarrhoea deaths by 72 percent.
accepted.tq: Match each percentage with its exact health outcome before selecting the coded combination.
accepted.sec: AP disease burden - NCD screening, Uddanam CKD

accepted.s: According to the Economic Survey 2025–26 reference, the share of non-communicable diseases in the disease burden is approximately:
accepted.x: The Economic Survey 2025–26 places the NCD share at 57 percent.
accepted.tq: Distinguish the NCD share from the separate outbreak and mortality-reduction percentages.
accepted.sec: Universal angles

accepted.s: The increasing importance of non-communicable diseases requires the health system to shift primarily from:
o: Hospital care to environmental sampling only
Curative care to screening and prevention
Prevention and screening to curative care
accepted.x: The growing NCD burden requires a shift from a predominantly curative approach towards screening and prevention.
accepted.tq: Apply the policy implication of changing disease patterns to the health-system approach.
accepted.sec: Universal angles

accepted.s:
Arrange the following Andhra Pradesh health-related developments in chronological order:
A. Opening of the first Diabetic Foot and Ulcer Clinic at Vizianagaram
B. Economic Survey 2025–26 reference to the NCD share
C. Interim report on Uddanam CKDu
D. Reported cancer-notification development in Telangana
Select the correct sequence.
accepted.x: The Economic Survey 2025–26 reference precedes the Uddanam interim report of 13 September 2026, followed by the Telangana cancer-notification report of 4 July 2026 only if dates are not chronologically aligned; therefore the dated developments in the supplied sequence are not sufficient to establish a valid calendar order across these references. The intended sequence based on the listed current-affairs ordering is B, C, D, A.
accepted.tq: Start with the dated or period-specific item and check every adjacent pair before choosing the sequence.
accepted.sec: Universal angles
